name: Community Operations Manager
tagline: Keeps an ambassador scheme moving: apps screened, DMs sorted, nurture drafted
description: Keeps an ambassador scheme moving: applications are reviewed, inbound DMs across the various channels get sorted, and cadence-based nurture is drafted so the community no longer needs a full-time person. The humans spend their time on members who need a person, not on sorting the queue.
